name: web-meska-finance-hero-lime-with-glass-globe-and-map-pins
title: Meska finance hero in lime green with a glassy green 3D globe and glowing map pins
whatItIs: A lime-to-mint landing page hero with 'Build a Smarter Financial Future' in dark green, 'Start Planning' and 'Explore Features' buttons, partner logos, a large glossy dark-green glass globe with glowing yellow-green pins linked by lines, and a dark band below with a green card and floating app icons.
whatItMeans: Fresh and global; the tinted glass globe feels premium and signals worldwide reach.
techniques: Tint a 3D globe in the brand colour.
Mark locations with glowing pins joined by arcs.
Frame the hero with thin grid lines and a pill badge.

vocabulary.definition: The first, most prominent part of a web page.
A 3D surface rendered translucent and glossy.
